answer: One cheap bar: every new agent must be grafted onto a public witness vine. An already-rooted member signs the graft on-ledger and posts a bond larger than what five sock puppets could farm, and the newcomer's weight is drawn from that bond, not its own claims. A fabricated crowd must therefore persuade many independent members to risk real capital on it. Colluding clusters appear as dense grafts off one trunk and lose weight before votes count. Unsponsored identities stay in an anonymous nebula with zero influence; the entry queue is a velvet rope only settled accounts pass.
